title: fix(plugin-sharing): a minted share link carries its organization, never NULL (ADR-0131 D9, C8 stage 8b-0h)
body:
Part of #15212
Clause-②: no

C8 stage 8b-0h (claim 6259036738, pointer 6258557956, plan amendment 11 6259028550). `ShareLinkService.createLink` stamps `sys_share_link.organization_id`, so a minted link is never a NULL row. #15212 remains open; stage 8b and the rest of C8 are not in this PR.

## What changed

`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/share-link-service.ts`: a new private `resolveMintOrganization`. It runs after the authority and eligibility checks and before the insert. In order:

1. **The linked record's organization.** One read under the system context: `fields: ['id', TENANT_FIELD]`, with the tenant field from `resolveTenantFieldName`. It takes the system context so that field-level masking cannot hide the column. The record's organization wins over the session's.
2. **The acting context's organization** (`tenantId`), when the record names none: an object with no tenant column, or a row with no organization.
3. **The ADR-0131 D9 predicate** (`resolveSystemWriteOrganization`, from `@objectstack/core` through `@objectstack/objectql`'s re-export of the same binding). Under `single` with exactly one organization, it derives the Default Organization. Otherwise it refuses with the engine's own `SystemWriteOrganizationRequiredError` (`ERR_SYSTEM_WRITE_ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED`, status 500). That covers a walled posture, and a `single` install with none or several organizations. Nothing is written.

The stamp rides both the row and the write context (`{ ...SYSTEM_CTX, tenantId }`), the shape `SharingService.grant` uses for `sys_record_share`. The mint response is still the contract's `ShareLink` shape, which declares no organization column. Nothing is stamped when `sys_share_link` has no tenant column, or when the composition registers no `sys_organization`; the probe answers `[]` without a read, like the engine's own probe.

The posture is the **requested** one (`resolveTenancyPosture()`). `resolveAuthzContext`'s platform-anchor read and the `tenancy` service's `defaultOrgId()` read the same source in the same fail-stricter direction: a deployment that asked for a wall stays walled here even when it runs degraded.

## Why the service decides (not the engine)

`sys_share_link` is `unclassified` in the #13491 ledger, so `Engine.resolveSystemInsertOrganization` returns early for it (`isPlatformObjectOutOfTenantAuditScope`, `engine.ts` about `:7183`), and today the NULL insert goes through. The service raises the engine's own refusal envelope, so a walled mint gets the same answer before and after 8b retires that exemption. This PR does not touch the engine or the ledger.

## Measured (dispatch assumptions)

- **A1 (one writer): holds.** On `538f923cb`, `git grep` for `insert|create|upsert('sys_share_link'` finds one site: `share-link-service.ts:665`. `revokeLink` and the usage stamp only update existing rows.
- **A2 (record read before insert): falsified.** The existing read is `fields: ['id']` unless an eligibility predicate is declared. It runs under the caller's context, where field-level masking applies. So the stage adds the narrowest system read, `['id', TENANT_FIELD]`. A failing read propagates, so the mint fails and nothing is written. The stage never stamps the session's organization in place of an unknown record organization.
- **A3 (cross-organization link): possible under `group`.** Layer 0 is a membership union there, so a member active in A can mint on a visible record in B. The `isolated` wall is equality, so both are the same. The owner and Modify-All alternative is withheld under a wall. A system caller reads under the system context. In every case the record's organization is stamped (pin 1).
- **A5 / Clause-②.** No in-repo caller reaches the new refusal. The only `createLink` callers are the two HTTP doors (`share-link-routes.ts:362`, `runtime/src/domains/share-links.ts:433`). Both require a `userId`. Under a wall, an organization-less API key is refused at admission (`share-link-tenancy-posture-admission.test.ts`). An organization-less session fails Layer 0 on any tenant-columned record, so the visibility check refuses first. No in-repo object pairs `publicSharing` with `tenancy.enabled: false`; the only `publicSharing` object is showcase's `client-brief`, which is tenant-columned. The refusal is reachable only by an external system caller that threads no `tenantId`, or by a third-party organization-less object. So the claim's `Clause-②: no` is kept as written.
- **A6 (size):** +281 / -1 over 3 files (the changeset, the service and a new 135-line pin), inside the 0.1–0.3k estimate.

## Tests

- New `share-link-organization-stamp.test.ts`: a real `ObjectQL` and `SqlDriver` (better-sqlite3 `:memory:`), the real `SysShareLink` object, and rows read back off the driver. The posture is stubbed through `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE`.
  - (0) The registered `sys_share_link` carries the tenant column.
  - (1) Walled: the row gets the record's organization, even when the caller acts in another.
  - (2) Walled: a record with no organization gets the caller's.
  - (3) `single`: the Default Organization, and the response has no `organization_id`.
  - (4) Walled with neither: the refusal envelope (`code` and `status`), and zero rows.
- **Ablations**, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, on commit `36706e5e`. Every anchor hit 1 → 0, and every restore showed blob == HEAD with an empty `git diff HEAD`. The test imports `./share-link-service.js` from `src`, so no build or dist step is involved.
  - Drop the record-organization return: only pin 1 goes red (1 failed / 4 passed).
  - Drop the session fallback: only pin 2 goes red.
  - Drop the `derived` return: only pin 3 goes red.
  - Turn the refusal into `return undefined`: only pin 4 goes red.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing test`: 49 files, 1144 tests pass. `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/share-links`: 6 files, 202 tests pass. These suites construct `ShareLinkService`.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 67 commands, plus the 53 artifact-roster families printed on STDERR (118 unique). All of them were run, and the readings are in the dev report on #15212. The first run found two real problems, both fixed in `a117f81c`:

- `check-tenant-audit-census`: a conditional insert context counted as "elevation undecidable". It is now `{ ...SYSTEM_CTX, tenantId }`.
- `check:query-options-erasure`: 5 → 7 because of two `as any` casts on find options. Both casts are dropped.

The rest exit non-zero only because they cannot measure locally. Four need PR context (`closing-target-claim`, `partof-closing-keyword`, `single-claim-paths`, `governed-queue-guard`). One needs an unshallowed clone (`check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`). Three need a full workspace build (`check:i18n`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:published-readme-exports`). All of these are NOT MEASURED locally and are left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- The `sys_share_link` row in `platform-object-tenancy.ts` is still `unclassified`. With the writer now stamping, it is ready for 8b, which owns the engine-side change; that is not done here.
- The `sys_share_link` row in `organization-ownership-inventory.ts` (`fate: 'attribution'`, subject anchor `object_name` / `record_id`) already matches this stamp. No change is needed.
- `sharing-plugin.ts` is not touched. The stage needs no new wiring, because the posture is the requested one and the Default Organization comes from the same D9 probe the engine uses.
